hero.title: Learn a language you will actually use
hero.subtitle: Short lessons, real conversations and assessments that tell you where you stand. Built for learners who want progress they can measure.

tracks.title: Two tracks, one way of learning
tracks.subtitle: Each track declares its own level scale. We never pretend an HSK level is a CEFR level.
tracks.englishBody: From everyday conversation to academic writing and the language of the workplace.
tracks.chineseBody: Pinyin and tones first, then the vocabulary of daily life, travel and business.

how.title: How a course works
how.stepOneBody: You join a specific version of the course and stay on it, even when a newer one is published.
how.stepTwoBody: Video, reading and practice. Mark a lesson complete and your progress follows you across devices.
how.stepThreeBody: You see the rules before you start: attempts, time limit, pass mark and which attempt counts.

instructors.title: Author a course that holds up
instructors.body: Versioned content, a question bank that freezes what has been graded, and checks that run before anything is published.

closing.title: Pick a course and start this week
closing.body: Enrolment is free on every open edition.
